proposals.proposal:
Inspect the Daily Blog Post workflow log for the failure reason and patch it. The most common cause at this step in the repo's history is a missing or rotated API key in the GitHub Actions environment. Check that the secret used by the workflow (likely OPENAI_API_KEY or a CMS deploy token) is still present and unexpired in the repository settings. If the secret is intact, the failure is more likely a schema mismatch against src/content.config.ts (which is a blocked path, so Fred cannot touch it, but Joel can). Fix the broken workflow so that the queue begins refilling before the last post publishes. Do not edit .github/workflows/* directly if that path is blocked — instead, surface the log error to Joel so he can apply the one-line fix manually.

Note: .github/workflows/* is a blocked path for Fred's automated commits. This proposal flags the fix for Joel to apply by hand after reading the Action log. Risk is medium because the root cause is unknown without the log.

---
title: "Why do I check my bank balance at 2am but not in daylight?"
pubDate: 2026-08-03
description: "You earn enough. You know you do. So why does the urge arrive at night, in the dark, when no one is watching?"
tags: ["money vigilance", "financial behaviour", "money anxiety"]
---

You earn enough. You know you do.

So why does the urge arrive at night, when the phone screen is the only light in the room?

You open the app. You look at the number. The number is the same number it was this morning. You close the app. You open it again.

This is not a budgeting problem.

The 2am check is not about the balance. It is about what the balance is supposed to confirm, and the fact that it never quite does. Something underneath the figure keeps the question open. The number could be higher and the feeling would still be there.

I have sat with clients who earn well above six figures and do the same thing. The balance is not the point. The point is the quiet alarm that stays on even when there is nothing to warn against.

If you recognise that, it is worth asking what the checking is actually for. Not as a criticism. As a real question.

That is usually where the useful work begins.

---

Joel Gould  
MSc Behavioural Economics | Qualified Financial Planner
